customKeycodes.name: HK_SAVE
customKeycodes.title: Save the current holykeebs settings to EEPROM

customKeycodes.name: HK_RESET
customKeycodes.title: Reset the holykeebs settings to their defaults

customKeycodes.name: HK_DUMP
customKeycodes.title: Dump the holykeebs settings to the console (debug firmware only)

customKeycodes.name: HK_P_SET_D
customKeycodes.title: Hold, then tap up/down to change the pointer sensitivity

customKeycodes.name: HK_P_SET_S
customKeycodes.title: Hold, then tap up/down to change the sniping sensitivity

customKeycodes.name: HK_P_SET_THR
customKeycodes.title: Hold, then tap up/down to change the ball's scroll throttle

customKeycodes.name: HK_S_MODE
customKeycodes.title: Hold for sniping mode (slow, precise pointer)

customKeycodes.name: HK_D_MODE
customKeycodes.title: Hold for drag scroll (ball movement scrolls)

customKeycodes.name: HK_C_SCROLL
customKeycodes.title: Cycle the scroll lock: off, horizontal, vertical

customKeycodes.name: HK_AML_UP
customKeycodes.title: Increase the auto-mouse layer timeout by 50ms

customKeycodes.name: HK_AML_DN
customKeycodes.title: Decrease the auto-mouse layer timeout by 50ms

customKeycodes.name: HK_BONGO_T
customKeycodes.title: Toggle the bongocat OLED animation (hold shift for the other half)

customKeycodes.name: HK_ENC_SCR_U
customKeycodes.title: Scroll up by one scroll wheel detent

customKeycodes.name: HK_ENC_SCR_D
customKeycodes.title: Scroll down by one scroll wheel detent
